# Table schemas

The normalized tables have the same columns for every iteration of the auditfile.
Columns a version does not have are null. See
[Interoperability](../guide/interop.md) for how to export them.

Logical types map to Arrow types as follows: `string` → `utf8`, `int64` → `int64`,
`date` → `date32`, `bool` → `bool`, `decimal(p,s)` → `decimal128(p,s)`. CSV and JSONL
write decimals as exact strings and dates as ISO 8601.

| Table | Rows | Columns |
|---|---|---|
| [`header`](#header) | one row: file header and detected version | 11 |
| [`company`](#company) | one row | 5 |
| [`addresses`](#addresses) | company and customer/supplier addresses | 12 |
| [`accounts`](#accounts) | ledger accounts (with RGS reference) | 13 |
| [`relations`](#relations) | customers/suppliers | 15 |
| [`vat_codes`](#vat_codes) | VAT codes | 5 |
| [`periods`](#periods) | periods | 6 |
| [`journals`](#journals) | journals | 8 |
| [`transactions`](#transactions) | journal entries (with line counts and debit/credit totals) | 13 |
| [`lines`](#lines) | transaction lines with their transaction context | 36 |
| [`line_vat`](#line_vat) | VAT details of transaction lines (`line_seq` → `lines.seq`) | 8 |
| [`opening_balance`](#opening_balance) | opening-balance lines (from the element or period-0/opening transactions) | 11 |
